.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/cre.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to scaffold the singleton, where <id> is the singleton's identifier.

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/lis.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] where searchTerm is an optional substring to filter singleton ids by.

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/upd.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> <change-request> to verify the singleton identified by `<id>` exists before it is updated.

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/del.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to delete the singleton with the given id, exiting with an error if it does not exist.
Run {{script}} <id> to print every `[file path]:[line number]` reference to the singleton's camelCase identifier found in the codebase.

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/eva.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the singleton's id, e.g. `{{script}} userSession`.

create.text: Scaffolds a new singleton file at src/src/singletons/{name}.singleton.ts with a minimal shared instance, given an id and optional initial content.

list.text: Lists singletons in the codebase matching an optional search term, printing each as "[id]: [file path]".

update.text: Updates an existing singleton's source file to satisfy a natural-language change request, given its id, erroring if the singleton doesn't exist.

delete.text: Deletes a singleton artifact by id, removing its file and cleaning up dangling references to it across the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that the singleton artifact with the given id has correct file location, export name, and single top-level shape, printing pass or itemized rule violations.
